pilot_cv.method: stratified 5-fold CV, 20 epochs, seed 0; same models score each held-out file single-window (first 4 s) and multi-window (mean of 4 s windows, 2 s hop, tail window at clip end)

diagnosis.note: Per-window scores, model.pth (pilot LCNN, trained on first 4 s of every clip). On real clips the first window (contains ~2 s leading silence) scores ~0 while later, speech-dense windows score up to 1.0: the pilot model keys partly on leading silence / clip onset, not only synthesis artefacts. Multi-window averaging exposes it. run_cv_study.py does not seed torch init, so pilot numbers vary run to run; single vs multi are paired within one run.
